{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=19|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 84 [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[Israel]]i attacks on [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/5/19/live-israel-kills-144-palestinians-targets-north-gaza-hospital?update=3720832 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Over 70 [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants are killed along the [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiran]]–[[Middle Shabelle]] border in [[Somalia]] in an overnight military operation by the [[Somali National Army]] and local defense fighters from Hiran. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/May/201565/somali_army_kills_over_70_al_shabaab_militants_in_major_counter_offensive.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]

'''Arts and culture''' 
*National [[broadcasting|broadcasters]] [[VRT (broadcaster)|VRT]] of [[Belgium]] and [[RTVE]] of [[Spain]] call for a debate on [[Israel]]'s [[Israel in the Eurovision Song Contest|participation]] in the [[Eurovision Song Contest]]. [https://www.semana.es/television/cadena-belga-vtr-se-une-a-rtve-y-hace-exigencia-a-organizacion-eurovision-uer_2798703 (Semana)]
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Indian [[2025 National highway 66 Collapse at Kooriyad, Malappuram|National Highway 66 collapses]] in Kooriyad, Malappuram district, [[Kerala]]. Four cars on the service road are damaged in the collapse and seven passengers are injured. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/kerala/nitin-gadkari-has-promised-action-against-those-responsible-for-nh-66-collapse-in-malappuram-iuml-leader/article69600882.ece (The Hindu)] [https://www.cnbctv18.com/india/nh66-collapse-in-kerala-malappuram-raises-safety-concerns-gadkari-assures-probe-19608393.htm (CNBC TV18)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kozhikode/nh-66-collapse-geotechnical-experts-assess-site-in-kooriyad/articleshow/121324083.cms (The Times of India)]
'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[Iran]]ian [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|foreign ministry]] summons the [[Embassy of the United Kingdom, Tehran|British]] [[chargé d'affaires]] to protest the arrest of seven [[Iranian nationality law|Iranian nationals]] in [[London]] earlier this month. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-summons-british-diplomat-over-arrest-of-nationals/a-72587364 (DW)]
*[[Mbanie Island#Territorial dispute|Mbanie Island territorial dispute]]
**The [[International Court of Justice]] rules 13–2 that [[Equatorial Guinea]] possesses sovereignty of the islands of Conga, Mbanié, and Cocoteros in a [[territorial dispute]] with [[Gabon]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckgq204n1vxo (BBC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/icj-backs-equatorial-guinea-in-gabon-islands-dispute/a-72600756 (DW)] [https://worldoil.com/news/2025/5/19/equatorial-guinea-wins-rights-to-islands-following-long-dispute-with-gabon/ (Bloomberg via WorldOil)]
*[[Post-Brexit United Kingdom relations with the European Union]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] and [[European Union]] conclude a deal on travel, food and metals exports, fishing access, and [[border control|border security]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2025/may/19/fishing-erasmus-uk-eu-deal-keir-starmer (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 New Orleans jailbreak]]
**A fourth escaped inmate, of a total of 10 escapees, is captured following the mass escape of prisoners in [[New Orleans]], [[Louisiana]], [[United States]]. Six escaped prisoners remain at large. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/11-men-escape-new-orleans-jail-considered-armed/story?id=121879077 (ABC News)]
*[[Lithuania]] files a lawsuit against [[Belarus]] with the [[International Court of Justice]], accusing it of orchestrating the [[Belarus–European Union border crisis|migrant crisis]] and violating international law. [https://www.baltictimes.com/lithuania_takes_belarus_to_hague_court_over_migrant_crisis_triggered_by_lukashenko_regime/ (''Baltic Times'')]
*[[Russia]] bans [[Amnesty International]] as an [[Russian undesirable organizations law|undesirable organisation]], accusing the group of openly supporting [[Ukraine]] in its [[Russo-Ukrainian War|war with Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-bans-amnesty-international-undesirable-organisation-ifax-says-2025-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*The trial of former [[Brazilian president]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] and 80 other officials begins in [[Brasília]]. Bolsonaro, who is accused of plotting the [[8 January Brasília attacks]], faces up to 40 years in prison if convicted. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250519-bolsonaro-s-trial-on-coup-charges-to-begin-in-brazil (France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Philippine general election]]
**The nominees of the winning [[Party-list representation in the House of Representatives of the Philippines|party-lists]] of the [[2025 Philippine House of Representatives elections#Party-list election 2|election]] held on May 12 are proclaimed. However, the proclamation of party-lists [[Duterte Youth]] and [[Bagong Henerasyon]] are suspended due to pending disqualification cases, leaving four seats unresolved. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/946634/52-party-list-groups-proclaimed-as-eleksyon-2025-winners/story/ (GMA News)]
